payload.summary: Refined ri-02 from live production evidence. The selected design keeps Railway isolated at /web, makes its artifact build locked and Node-only, and moves generated-contract enforcement into a full-toolchain CI gate before an explicitly scoped production deployment.

decisions.title: Use an isolated npm production build
decisions.rationale: Railway currently selects npm for the /web root; matching that observed boundary avoids platform-only root changes.

decisions.title: Run contract drift in CI
decisions.rationale: The generator requires repository-level Python/uv inputs that are intentionally absent from the static build context.

next_steps: Validate and review the plan, then implement the locked production build test-first.

relevant_files.description: Build, CI, deployment, and rollback decisions
